documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter
Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Forcas Studio reported a landmark FY26 with revenue from operations growing nearly 39% year-on-year to approximately Rs. 198 crores and PAT increasing around 58% to approximately Rs. 13.6 crores. Management highlighted strong performance driven by brand acceptance, distribution, online traction, operating leverage, and omni-channel presence including e-commerce and Quick Commerce. Looking ahead to FY27, the company remains confident of delivering approximately 25% to 30% annual growth while focusing on scaling brands like TRIBE and launching Fitness Exchange (FTX).

guidance.claim: The company remains confident of delivering approximately 25% to 30% annual growth while continuing to improve profitability and brand strength.
guidance.quote: Based on our current visibility and expansion plans, we remain confident of delivering approximately 25% to 30% annual growth while continuing to improve profitability and brand strength.

guidance.claim: Quick commerce revenue is expected to reach 5% to 10% of total revenue.
guidance.quote: I believe going forward, quick commerce should be at least, between 5% to 10% of our total revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the Indian organized fashion market continues to offer long-term opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian organized fashion market continues to offer long-term opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: Management believes that the next large opportunity in fashion will emerge through Quick Comm and instant fashion delivery.
demand_outlook.quote: We believe the next large opportunity in fashion will emerge through Quick Comm and instant fashion delivery.

demand_outlook.claim: Winter wear products on Zepto are seeing very good traction with 10-minute deliveries.
demand_outlook.quote: So we are seeing very good traction in our winter wear products, including jackets, sweatshirt, sweatpants, through Zepto and we are delivering it within 10 minutes.

demand_outlook.claim: Kurtas are driving business exceptionally well on quick commerce platforms.
demand_outlook.quote: Also, we have launched Kurtas, and surprisingly, Kurtas is doing very, very well. It was a first test to see how Kurtas does in quick commerce, but we have seen Kurtas are really driving our business in quick commerce.

capex_expansion.claim: The company announced its planned expansion into Quick Comm during FY27 by preparing to partner with more quick commerce platforms.
capex_expansion.quote: In line with this vision, we are pleased to announce our planned expansion into Quick Comm during FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to aggressively expand the brand TRIBE into men and women premium bottoms.
capex_expansion.quote: Going forward, we will aggressively expand TRIBE into men and women premium bottoms.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is launching Fitness Exchange as a separate brand focusing on active wear, athleisure, sports-inspired fashion and accessories.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we are launching Fitness Exchange as a separate brand which will operate in the semi-premium affordable segment and will focus on active wear, athleisure, sports-inspired fashion and also accessories.

capex_expansion.claim: Warehouse holding capacity was increased from 6 lakh pieces to 2 million units.
capex_expansion.quote: So since last year till date, we have increased our warehouse capacity from 6 lakh pieces holding capacities it has got to 2 million units holding capacity.

margins_costs.claim: Quick Commerce helps lower logistics costs, forward courier charges, and return courier charges drastically.
margins_costs.quote: What happens with Quick Comm is that your logistics cost, the forward courier charges and the return courier charges go down drastically.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin for H2FY26 was reported at 25.8 percent.
EBITDA margin for H2FY26 stood at 10.7 percent.
Profit after tax margin for H2FY26 was 6.9 percent.
margins_costs.quote: Profit After Tax Margin (%) 6.9% 6.9% 6.6% +35 bps +1 bps 6.9% 6.1% +83 bps

margins_costs.claim: Year-on-year EBITDA margin is up by 72.3%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin has been, it's up by 72.3%.

margins_costs.claim: Commission rates across online and quick commerce channels average 30% to 33%.
Kids' wear EBITDA margins are 10% to 15% better than men's wear, and women's wear margins are 20% to 30% better.
margins_costs.quote: So the kids and women kids, I would say, is at least 10% to 15% better than men's and women is 20% to 30% better than men's.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the company is currently at 120 stores on Zepto for Quick Comm expansion.
orders_capacity.quote: Today we are at 120 stores and also, we are expanding our SKUs and designs in all those.

orders_capacity.claim: Goods are currently stocked across nine states for e-commerce and over 15 to 16 cities for quick commerce.
orders_capacity.quote: So today, our goods are being stocked at around nine states. And that is for e-commerce, and for quick commerce it is being stocked at more than 15 - 16 cities in their dark store through which it is, again, dispatched and delivered through around 50 to 60 small towns and cities.

capital_allocation.claim: Warrants issued are 70% to 80% subscribed by the Managing Director and his brother.
capital_allocation.quote: This warrant issued is 70% - 80% subscribed by me and my brother.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted talent acquisition and the brandification process as the two main challenges or bottlenecks to solve.
risks_headwinds.quote: I believe, honestly, there are two challenges which we need to solve. Number one, yes, talent is one thing which we need to focus more on and need to hire more people from the industry and established brands. And number two is the brandification process, it doesn't have a particular way of doing.

risks_headwinds.claim: The market is experiencing a raw material crisis and a supply shortage for winter wear.
risks_headwinds.quote: And there is a huge crisis of the raw material. But with us, the situation is completely different. Our targets for the winter wear sales are almost going to be achieved or probably we will overachieve that.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to be live on Flipkart Minutes by next month.
management_commitments.quote: Going forward, probably by next month itself, we should be live on Flipkart Minutes.

management_commitments.claim: The company announced its planned expansion into Quick Comm during FY27.
management_commitments.quote: In line with this vision, we are pleased to announce our planned expansion into Quick Comm during FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the FY27 focus will be scaling brands, expanding Quick Commerce presence, strengthening omni-channel distribution, improving margins, and building stronger consumer connect.
management_commitments.quote: So, our FY27 focus will be scaling our brands, expanding Quick Commerce presence, strengthening our omni-channel distribution, improving our margins and building stronger consumer connect.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to launch a women's sportswear line in the budget segment of ₹299 to ₹599 / ₹499 starting from Q3.
management_commitments.quote: We also plan to launch a women sportswear line in the same budget segment ₹299 to ₹599, ₹499 from Q3.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
